summary: Two corrections and one collapse. Correction one: last week's read that her invoice-2 silence was a dispute forming was wrong. She had already paid. On Aug 21 Derrek asked her to "clear this up" and she answered inside 40 seconds - "Yes sent :)" / "Via wire, the Zelle limit wasn’t enough". Correction two: the money still has not arrived. On Aug 24 she flagged "Hey just fyi my bank sent me this just now from the wire on Friday", on Aug 27 she confirmed "Hey so I just checked and it was rejected. I will try again now and if it doesn’t work I’ll call and see what’s the issue", re-sent, and it went "under review again". Thirteen days after invoice 2 was issued, ALTR has not been paid - and the single most likely cause is the changed bank account number Stephski put on that invoice on Aug 15, which nobody ever re-confirmed with her separately despite that being last week's explicit recommendation. She is not the problem here; she has now attempted payment twice and offered to phone her bank. The collapse is service delivery. Ollie Mckinlay sent ONE message in the entire seven-day window - "Okay perfect thank you" on Aug 22 - while carrying five overdue items: the written chatter-boundary confirmation (26 days), the whale-reactivation report (21 days), the CodyBeebs proof screenshot (10 days, promised "Yes Ill get that for you"), the third outstanding custom, and the livestream. The livestream is the clearest loss: he ran a subscriber poll specifically so she could go live, she said Friday or Saturday, it slipped on Aug 21 ("Today and tomorrow will no longer work. Sometime this week or weekend will do"), and then nobody - including Ollie - mentioned it again. It never happened. Derrek reappeared after 20 days of silence, but only to chase money: six messages this week, every single one about the wire, none about the $40k phone farm he announced on Aug 1 or the Meta ad report she asked for 25 days ago that is still attached to the fee she is being invoiced. Michelle held the account up alone again - weekly leak report on time on Aug 25, unchased, and same-day resolution of the wall-photos drive question. Volume collapsed from 81 messages to 29 (15 hers), and she leaves for LA on Aug 24 for 10 days then Mexico for Labor Day weekend.

health.rationale: Down 9 from 64. One thing got better and it is real: the payment risk is not a dispute. She paid by wire on Aug 21 within seconds of being asked, told the team her Zelle limit was too small, chased her own bank when it bounced, and re-sent on Aug 27. That removes the churn/withholding read. Everything else got worse. The wire has still not landed 13 days after invoice 2, most plausibly because of the account-number change ALTR made on Aug 15 and never separately confirmed - so the agency has an unpaid invoice caused by its own banking admin, with invoice 3 due Aug 29 on top of it. Derrek's only appearance in 27 days was four payment chases (Aug 21, Aug 25, Aug 27) with no ad report and no phone-farm update - exactly the sequencing last week's report warned against. Ollie went to one message in seven days on an account with five open items he owns, and the livestream he built a poll for quietly died with nobody following up. Client volume halved (32 client messages to 15) and she is now travelling for 10+ days, which is the same pattern that stalled customs for three weeks in July. Held above 50 only because her own conduct was cooperative throughout and Michelle's promo and DMCA lines are still clean.
